cases.name: Ashley Lynn Newton McClung
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said, "She was a wonderful mother who loved her children more than anything in the world and was also a kind, genuine and sincere friend to many." Her obituary said, "Ashley was a lifelong resident of Cherokee. She worked as a medical assistant at Shoals Primary Care and was of the Baptist faith. Ashley was a loving and devoted mother, attended all of her children’s sporting events and activities. She loved fishing, singing, and going to the beach."
